name: cache-watch
description: A band above the prompt showing whether the prompt cache is warm or cold, the estimated re-cache cost, a warning before it goes cold, and a Keep warm button.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after each response. 'auto' reads it from the last response (1h if it wrote a 1-hour entry, else 5m).

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before cold
warnMinutes.description: Capped at 20% of the lifetime, so a 5m cache warns at 1 minute.

inputUsdPerMTok.title: Base input price override ($ per million tokens)
inputUsdPerMTok.description: 0 = guess from the model name (opus 5, sonnet 3, haiku 1). Cache write is 1.25x (5m) or 2x (1h) of this; a read is 0.1x.
